label: ACCEPT
reason: The only outlier is RuntimeException itself (runtime.exception.ts extends Error), the base class definition, so it is set aside; every other core exception (circular-dependency, undefined-module, unknown-element) extends RuntimeException. A new core exception extending bare Error compiles fine and no lint rule catches it, and it is a house base-class choice worth flagging.
